attributes.name: Returning Frost Spear +2
attributes.powers:
For your combat check, reveal this card to use your Dexterity or Ranged skill + 1d8+2; you may additionally recharge this card to add another 2d6 and the Cold trait.

If proficient with weapons, discard this card to add 1d4+2 to a combat check by a character at another location.
